feedback.agent: Tayler B. · Keller Williams Realty Hoover
feedback.note: **Interested: Yes. Priced right: Just right.** Staging 4. *“Flood plain is main concern. Age of major systems and roof are of concern. Loves the space and the ‘homey’ feel.”*
*“They loved the townhouse… initially wanted to write an offer but changed their minds because of the flood plain. Lovely listing.”* Every answer box left blank but the last.
Sent the buyer-signed packet at 2:20 PM — purchase agreement, addenda, pre-approval — with *“Let me know that you have received.”* She never got an answer, and the contract died.
Wrote unprompted at 5:51 AM — *“an adorable townhouse”* — and said her buyer is forwarding it to a husband who works out of town. The house reopened Monday.
The first feedback form this address ever produced, and it never challenged the price. Four tours, three brokerages, not one price objection.
